why:
Measured against the recorded upstream surfaces (`docs/reference/api-surface/{rclc,rclcpp,rclrs}.json`): none of them contains `park`, `wake_source`, `spin_nominal` or `granularity` at all, so there is no upstream name to align to. Same basis as the `Executor::release_jitter` pair beside it.

phase-436 W7. The finest park the installed primitive can express. Replaces a hardcoded `1_000` justified by "every `nros_platform_wake_*` port takes `uint32_t timeout_ms`" — right for FreeRTOS by coincidence, wrong for the other two, and it made the W3 jitter report over-claim on ThreadX, reproducing one layer below W3 the failure W3 exists to prevent. With nothing installed the fallback is 1 ms, the honest floor of the `wake_wait_ms` ABI every port exports today.
